decisions.reason: The dismantling joint was moved from a mention to its own page, so the firm has invested in it and committed to it visibly, and it fits the firm's core pipe and valve fabrication business, so management will persist despite no evidence after 2019.

The powder-coated public waste bin is part of a deliberately launched street-furniture line with its own page, and the investment in coating and tooling plus the public commitment favour keeping it, with weak results attributable to temporary pandemic effects on municipal demand.
The waste bin with ashtray shares production and the announced outdoor-furniture direction with Product D, so the costs already sunk and the need to justify the line argue for keeping it.

The standalone outdoor ashtray is the most peripheral item and has more volatile demand, but as part of the publicly presented product family, management would rather wait out the slump than admit the line failed.
